name: scrollhound
description: Social research for your AI: read Reddit threads, comment sections, X, LinkedIn, Threads, Bluesky and Facebook posts, Pinterest pins, ad libraries, and YouTube, TikTok and Instagram transcripts in full, with a link on every quote. Includes skills for voice of customer, comment mining, competitor and short-form teardowns, hooks, LinkedIn, weekly briefs, subreddit checks, brand mentions, trends in a niche, competitor ads, creator shortlists, ad swipe files, the Halo strategy, monthly messages reviews and outlier hunts. Read-only.
